name: Daisy Cubes Are Strictly Contained in Cube-Chordal Ample Classes
scope: Finite nonempty ample classes under the signed-coordinate and full ambient complement conventions; hierarchy parameters are held fixed.
statement: Every member of Daisy Cubes belongs to Cube-Chordal Ample Classes.
proof: All maximal cubes of a daisy share its root, so their graph is complete. The three-direction path has cube graph P_3 and cannot be a signed downset.
